question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the (bracketed) word in the given sentence.**

It would effectively rouse people's ardour to invest, and help to (discourage) the transfer of capital abroad.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Persuade'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The bracketed word in the sentence is** "discourage"**. (निराश करना). 
 
• The **correct antonym** to substitute "discourage" in this context is **"Persuade"**, which implies encouraging or convincing someone to do something,(विश्वास दिलाना)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is-** 'Persuade'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Industrious:** Hard-working or diligent.(परिश्रमी)
 
• **Construe:** Interpret in a particular way.(समझना)
 
• **Intolerable**: Unbearable.(असहनीय)
